name: Bangla Voice Typing
description: Command palette (Ctrl+K) to find and run every feature and switch between open tabs. Type in Bangla by speaking or by typing phonetically (tumi → তুমি), translate Bangla ↔ English with Alt+C, translate selected text from any language, and translate text inside images with Alt+V, and take HD screenshots (selected area or the whole scrolling page) with markup tools with Alt+S, keep a screenshot history in the browser, record the screen or a tab as WebM (with microphone), copy text out of screenshots, expand short codes into full text, find and replace words inside any text box with Ctrl+F / Alt+A, compress, resize and convert pictures or make a PDF from them (nothing is uploaded), and optionally use Gemini Flash or Chrome on-device spelling/grammar tools to fix English text.

translate-image.description: Translate text in an image, Bangla ↔ English (drag a box)

screenshot.description: Take a screenshot (select area, mark it up, save in HD). Alt+S already works on pages without setting this.

screen-record.description: Record an area of this tab (mark it with the mouse), WebM with optional microphone
